classification.difficultyReason: Distinguish input and output negation, apply both to the linear rule and recognise that the double reflection reproduces the original graph.

answer.worked: Draw the straight line through $(0,0)$ and $(1,3)$.

$$y=3x+4$$
Translate the graph of $y=3x$ up $4$ units.

$$y=-3x$$
Reflect the graph of $y=3x$ in the $x$-axis; $(1,3)$ becomes $(1,-3)$.

$$\begin{align*}y&=-3(-x)\\y&=3x\end{align*}$$
Reflect in the $y$-axis and then in the $x$-axis. The resulting line coincides with $y=f(x)$.

spec.description: Double reflection coincides with the original line.
